'''Loje Nella''' was an [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] [[cliffborer worm]] who worked as an assistant [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] to the [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]], in service to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], she watched the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] perform "[[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]]" in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Nella and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] court later caught [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] trying to [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] in the palace.

==Biography==
[[File:Loje_Nella_SWI_60.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Loje Nella]]
A reluctant employee of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], the [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] [[cliffborer worm]] Loje Nella served as an assistant [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] to<ref name="Nella, Loje" /> the [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]]<ref name="Who's Who in Mos Eisley">{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}}</ref> [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]]. However, she purposefully misappropriated Jabba's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to obstruct his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal activities]].<ref name="Nella, Loje" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Given that the title card of [["Lapti Nek": The Music Video from Jabba's Palace]] includes the ''Return of the Jedi'' logo, its events therefore also take place in 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> Nella watched the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] perform the [[Music/Legends|song]] "[[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]]" in the main audience chamber of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]<ref name="Lapti Nek">[["Lapti Nek": The Music Video from Jabba's Palace]]</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> from between the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jess/Legends|Jess]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]], two members of the Hutt's court.<ref name="Lapti Nek" /> Later, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|infiltrated]] the palace in [[Boushh/Legends|disguise]] to rescue the captive [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the Hutt's clutches. However, Jabba learned of her deception and lay in wait with members of his court to catch Organa in the act.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

[[File:HoorayForEvil.png|thumb|215px|Loje Nella, between Droopy McCool and Max Rebo, in Jabba's Palace]]
Between [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] and [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]] of the Max Rebo Band, Nella was hidden in a [[curtain]]ed<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> [[Turbolift/Legends|lift]] shaft<ref name="Junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> when the group caught Organa, having just freed Solo from [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in the connecting audience chamber. The Hutt and members of his entourage later attempted to [[Death/Legends|execute]] Solo, along with his allies [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], though much of the court was killed in the ensuing [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|battle]], including Jabba himself.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Personality and traits==
An individual covered in [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]], Nella had brown skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CCG" /> She was reluctant to work for Jabba<ref name="Nella, Loje" /> and intentionally mismanaged his funds.<ref name="CCG" /> Nella laughed when Jabba's court captured Leia Organa during her failed rescue attempt of Han Solo.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Conception and portrayal===
Originally created for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Loje Nella was portrayed via a puppet<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> operated by [[Mike Quinn]]<ref name="Quinn">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/mike-quinn-nien-nunb|text=Mike Quinn (Nien Nunb)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|work=[https://starwarsinterviews.com Star Wars Interviews]|quote=I have a vague memory of getting inside that Toadstool thing from under the set, too, at one point.|archivedate=20180124195951|nolive=1}}</ref> based on a maquette<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> and given the production nickname "Toadstool Terror" by the creature creators of the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] Monster Shop.<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" /> She was officially named by the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JabbasPalace-Light/large/lojenella.gif "Loje Nella" card] from the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], published by [[Decipher]].<ref name="CCG" />

On [[June 4]], [[2002]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020510.html|text=Post-''Clones'' Fan Magazines}}</ref> [[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]," an article written by [[Daniel Wallace]] for [[Star Wars Insider 60|''Star Wars Insider'' 60]], mistakenly claimed that Nella was cut from ''Return of the Jedi'',<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" /> despite being present in the background of the final film.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Cut footage of Nella was later used in [["Lapti Nek": The Music Video from Jabba's Palace]], a music video distributed by [[Wikipedia:MTV|MTV]] in 1983 to accompany the release of the [[Special Extended Dance Remix of Lapti Nek from the Original Soundtrack Recording of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi|"Lapti Nek" record]].<ref name="Lapti Nek" />

===Continuity===
[[File:Cliffborer_worm.png|thumb|right|200px|A ''Return of the Jedi'' production sketch of Loje Nella, reused for the cliffborer worm and the basis of the Riorian species]]
There existed a period of confusion surrounding the identity of Loje Nella's [[Species/Legends|species]]. The ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game described her as having "descended from a species of cliff boring [[Worm/Legends|worms]],"<ref name="CCG" /> in keeping with ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', a [[1995]] reference book written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]],<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> which depicted the cliffborer worm using a production sketch of Nella<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" /> by [[Joe Johnston]].<ref name="The Making of Return of the Jedi">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> Despite this, an image of Nella was edited by [[Cliff Nielsen]] and featured on the cover of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]'', a [[2000]] young-readers novel written by [[Jude Watson]], intended to represent a member of the [[Rutanian]] species.<ref name="The Shattered Peace">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref>

To further complicate matters, [[Leland Chee]], manager of [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Holocron continuity database]], initially claimed on the now-defunct [[StarWars.com Message Boards]] that Nella was a [[Riorian/Legends|Riorian]], another species based on concept art of the worm creature that would become Nella.<ref name="Riorian">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=01200#16270670|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-02-06|time=3:45 PM|quote=Similar-looking species, with any possible connection yet to be established. Loje Nella is actually a Riorian, since the Rioirian image shown in the RPG ''Wanted by Cracken'' is Ep VI concept art for the character referred to by production as the Toadstool Terror.}}</ref> However, Chee would later debate the accuracy of this and said that the identity of Nella's species should be determined in a future source.<ref name="Or Not">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1213|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|nobackup=1}}</ref> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]], ultimately confirmed that Nella was an "intelligent cliff-borer worm."<ref name="Nella, Loje" />

While "Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" referred to Nella as a him,<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" /> ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' referred to the character as a her. Given that ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' is the more recent source,<ref name="Nella, Loje" /> this article treats its material as the correct version.

Leland Chee went on to say that Nella was seen on the [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] during the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon, and it was unknown if she survived.<ref name="Q&A">{{InsiderCite|98|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> However, Nella is not visible on the ''Khetanna'' in the ''Return of the Jedi'' film,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> and no other licensed ''[[Star Wars]]'' media have shown her on the ''Khetanna''.
